thread:
anya (PM): Heads-up: multiple enterprise customers asked for streaming structured outputs + function/tool calling. They want incremental JSON so UI can render partial cards while model is still generating.

sam (eng): +1 on customer ask. Big question: SSE vs ws for this use case? Mobile apps prefer SSE for simplicity but websockets enable multiplexing.

luca (eng-rt): From runtime POV: both are doable. SSE simpler for proxies and HTTP infra, but WS gives lower overhead for many concurrent streams and clearer backpressure.

marie (research): Also need to clarify finish semantics when a function call is triggered mid-stream. Is finish_reason: "function_call_start" / "function_call_end" sufficient? What about partial function args delivered in multiple deltas?

anya (PM): We need explicit launch criteria. Proposal: MVP must support: 1) streaming plain text deltas (existing) 2) streaming JSON deltas for structured output 3) clear finish_reason values for function calls so clients can decide when to invoke tool. Non-blocker: multiplexing/multiple channels per connection.

sam (eng): Implementation risk: ensuring JSON validity for partial deltas without reassembly is hard. Options: a) send well-formed JSON fragments with an envelope that includes "chunk_index" and "more": true/false, b) send diffs/patches referencing a schema version. Both require client reassembly logic.

nora (devex): SDK impact huge. We should provide client helpers that reassemble structured deltas and emit higher-level events like onPartialStructured, onFunctionCallStart, onFunctionCallFinish. That reduces app-side work.

luca (eng-rt): Agree on helpers. For the runtime we can emit canonical events in the stream envelope. Example minimal envelope per delta:

```
{"type":"delta","delta_type":"struct","seq":12,"payload":{"path":"choices[0].message.content","value":"{\"foo\": 1"},"more":true}
```

Then final chunk with more:false completes the JSON.

marie (research): For function calls specifically, we propose finish_reason values: "stop" (normal completion), "function_call" (function completed and returned), "function_stream" (function args streaming and not yet complete), "incomplete" (truncated). Clients can treat "function_stream" + more:false as safe to invoke once reassembled.

anya (PM): Prioritization: Customers A and B require streaming-structured + function_call semantics in Q2 pilot. We should define MUST/SHOULD: MUST = structured deltas + deterministic finish_reason for function calls; SHOULD = binary diffs/patches; WANT = multiplexed ws channels.

sam (eng): Dev plan suggestion: Phase 1 (MVP): SSE/HTTP streaming with envelope deltas, clients reassemble. Phase 2: add WS multiplexing + backpressure improvements. Phase 3: patch/diff format and richer schema negotiation.

nora (devex): SDKs: ship JS, Python, and mobile helpers for phase1. Document the envelope, show example reassembly. Provide minimal polyfill for older fetch-based SSE clients.

luca (eng-rt): Telemetry/ops gates: need per-token latency percentiles, incomplete_function_call rates, reassembly_errors metric, and client-reported fallback usage. Launch block if reassembly_errors > 0.1% for canary.

marie (research): Edge-case: what if customer wants function args as streaming binary (e.g., attachments)? Envelope should support content_type and chunked base64. Also signal when payload is partial vs boundary-aligned.

anya (PM): Can we settle on a small set of finish_reason strings to avoid ambiguity? Proposal final list: ["stop","function_call","function_stream","cancel","timeout","incomplete"]. Any objections?

sam (eng): OK. Add: "fallback" when runtime switched to another model mid-stream. Good for client metrics.

anya (PM): Good call. Add "fallback". Final list: stop,function_call,function_stream,cancel,timeout,incomplete,fallback.

nora (devex): UI guidance: render partial structured data only when reassembled_verified == true. Expose reassembly progress. Don't auto-trigger function invocation until chunk with more:false and finish_reason == function_stream or function_call.

luca (eng-rt): SDK event model: onDelta(delta), onStructuredComplete(obj), onFunctionCall(functionMeta, args), onFinish(reason). We'll prototype in eng-rt branch.

anya (PM): Launch checklist (pilot):
- API: envelope format documented + schema v1 (MUST)
- SDKs: JS + Python helpers (MUST)
- Runtime: SSE endpoint + compatibility with existing streaming (MUST)
- Telemetry: reassembly_errors, incomplete_function_call, fallback_rate (MUST)
- Ops: canary rollout, 2 customers onboarded, <0.1% reassembly_errors (MUST)
- Optional: WS multiplexing gate (SHOULD)

sam (eng): Time estimates: eng-rt 6w for envelope + SSE, SDK 3w, docs 1w, telemetry 1w. Could we compress by parallel work?

anya (PM): We'll propose schedule to exec. If customers need WS earlier, we can accelerate but mark as higher risk/cost.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for feature/streaming-struct-v1 at 2024-11-02T18:22:00Z :rocket:

marie (research): Action items: I will write a short spec doc with example streams and finish_reason table. Sam/luca will draft runtime contract. Nora will draft SDK event API. We'll sync next Tue.

anya (PM): Thanks all. Quick poll: thumbs if you agree with MVP scope as MUST list above.

sam (eng): :thumbsup:

luca (eng-rt): :thumbsup:

nora (devex): :thumbsup:

anya (PM): Marking follow-up: /remind me to circulate spec and owner PRs by EOD tomorrow.

sam (eng): I'll add a short compatibility note for older clients (no structured support -> fall back to full-text stream + finish_reason stop).

anya (PM): Great. Closing thread for now.
